epistemic_role: Zero-sampling provenance and public-interface compatibility audit of legacy R5a against the remediated R6AF contract.
scientific_question: Can the legacy R5a cohort still support a complete two-stage public-decoder claim after R6AF separated full-binary decoder-visible records and relation-free charge actions from hidden action-conditioned generation and scoring truth?
rationale: R5a predates the R6AF fail-closed discovery that inactive -1 sentinels and hidden post-flux relations crossed the public action boundary. Its large cohort must be audited before any of its numerical results are reused as corrected complete-pipeline evidence.

audit_dimensions.required_check: Verify every frozen hash, declared completion status, raw record count, and analysis provenance before inspecting semantics.
Compare lattice normalization, red-X channel, physical-winding handling, sizes, and error parameters without comparing numerical risks.
Determine whether the R5a decoder-visible first record is the corrected signal-only binary record and whether it is sampled before the first action.
Audit physical, first-observation, and second-exogenous seed coupling across O0/O2 and whether policy-dependent second records are generated from each arm's own action.
Inspect raw R5a records for a full binary star field and separately identify internal -1 sentinels, active support, relation pairs, physical truth, and homology truth.
Establish whether the legacy charge action itself consumed hidden relations or active support, distinguishing action inputs from private generation, validation, and scoring inputs.
Verify each second record is conditioned on its own first action and that wrong-action records fail closed.
Compare physical-winding, first Boolean-union, and blue/green charge-residual loss semantics and confirm every attempted history remains in the denominator.
Determine whether legacy evidence contains public transcripts, relation-perturbation invariance, action binding, first/middle/final deterministic replay, and explicit private-field exclusion.
Classify each R5a result family as corrected complete-pipeline evidence, first-stage/provenance-only evidence, or withdrawn pending a separately registered rerun.

classification_rules.compatible: All public-information, causal, scorer, denominator, matched-randomness, and integrity dimensions are evidenced equivalent to R6AF; legacy finite-size results may retain their original bounded claim only.
classification_rules.partially_compatible_provenance_only: Physical or first-stage structure remains useful, but at least one complete-pipeline public-action or integrity gate is absent or fails; numerical final-loss results cannot support the remediated complete pipeline.
classification_rules.incompatible: A frozen witness shows that decoder-visible information, causal order, scorer, denominator, or action conditioning differs materially from R6AF.
classification_rules.censored: Missing or hash-mismatched evidence prevents a deterministic classification.

acceptance_gates: All frozen artifact hashes and registered statuses match.
Every audit dimension receives a machine-readable verdict with a direct evidence path and witness.
Stored private provenance is not mistaken for decoder-visible input; action, generation, validation, and scoring boundaries are classified separately.
No R5a/R6AF risk, interval, stage-count, size-trend, crossing, or threshold comparison is performed.
Any legacy result invalidated for complete-pipeline use is marked withdrawn or provenance-only in PLAN, REPORT, metadata, and Local Wiki before downstream reuse.
Exactly one overall compatibility verdict is issued under the frozen rules.

compute_budget.stop_rule: Stop after one deterministic evidence/status/hash audit, one dimension matrix, one verdict, and required evidence-boundary updates. Censor on a missing artifact, hash mismatch, unclassified dimension, or unsupported inference. Do not register or execute a rerun in the verdict tick.

registration_amendment.change: Route the prose audit record to wiki/records rather than results, as required by the lab evidence-integration contract.
registration_amendment.scientific_effect: None. Frozen evidence, audit dimensions, classification rules, acceptance gates, and zero-compute stop rule are unchanged.

audit_outcome.claim_usability: R5a physical/lattice records remain provenance; its complete-pipeline numerical risks, O0/O2 differences, stage mechanism, size directions, and Lab 005 baseline promotion are withdrawn.

next_action: In a later registration tick, preregister the smallest corrected replacement of the withdrawn R5a transfer question using the remediated R6AF public interface; do not reuse or reinterpret the legacy numerical cohort.
